[91] katamā ca bhikkhave sammāpaṭipatti . seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāpaṭipattīti . [92] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . micchāpaṭipannañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sammāpaṭipannañca taṃ suṇātha .
